title.name: BEYOND SAGITTARIUS
title.subtitle: A Survival Story Beyond the Known Universe
title.tagline: Six mixed-lineage besties. One black hole. Zero signal.
title.slice: Prologue + Chapter One: The First 24 Hours (levels 1–10)
menu.newGameConfirm: Starting a new game will erase your saved progress.
settings.title: Settings
settings.qualityNote: Changing quality reloads the game. Your progress is saved first.
controls.title: Controls
controls.look: Mouse: look around (click the world to lock the cursor)
controls.touch: Touch: joystick on the left moves, drag anywhere else to look, pinch to zoom; the buttons on the right use, jump and run
cine.caption1: By 2189 nobody is just human any more. Five alien lineages married into ours, and the group chats have never been worse.
cine.caption2: Six friends. One tourist liner. Zero adult supervision.
cine.mission2: DESTINATION: MILKY WAY GALACTIC CENTRE OBSERVATION CORRIDOR
cine.line1: Imagine if we actually find aliens.
cine.line2: Bro. Look at us. We are the aliens.
cine.line3: Six friends, one ship, the centre of the galaxy. This trip is giving main character energy.
cine.montage: Day 41: beyond the edge of charted space
cine.line5: That reading is impossible. Gravity doesn't do that.
cine.ai1: WARNING. UNIDENTIFIED GRAVITATIONAL DISTURBANCE DETECTED. NAVIGATION SYSTEMS EXPERIENCING ANOMALOUS DEVIATION.
cine.ai2: CRITICAL FAILURE. STRUCTURAL INTEGRITY: 41%. PROPULSION: OFFLINE. EMERGENCY PROTOCOL INITIATED.
cine.line7: Pods! Everyone to the pods, now!
cine.line8: Hold on to something! Hold on to me!
wake.line1: Ow. Okay. Either I'm dead, or this is a one-star stay on Trapadvisor.
wake.line2: Two worlds in the sky. That is not our Moon. That's nobody's Moon.
wake.line3: Hello? Squad? {f:social}? {f:strong}? Bro, even the group chat is dead.
wake.line4: Something is moving between the trees. Something huge. Nope. Nope nope nope.
wake.line5: Stay calm. Think like a scientist. Scientists drink water. Step one: don't die.

level.1.title: Find Water
level.1.desc: Your suit's water reserve is empty. Find a source of water and drink.
level.1.hint: Your suit sensor detects moisture. Follow the marker on the compass.
level.2.title: Find Food
level.2.desc: Your strength is fading. Find something you can safely eat.
level.2.hint: Strange fruit grows near the water. Examine before you eat.
level.3.title: Collect Stones and Branches
level.3.desc: Gather 5 stones and 5 branches. You will need them to make tools.
level.4.title: Make Fire
level.5.title: Build a Shelter
level.6.title: Craft a Spear
level.7.title: Survive the First Night
level.8.title: Find the Signal
level.9.title: Reunite with {f:explorer}
level.10.title: Light the Beacon
medic.hint: You remember {f:medic}, the Medic: “Never eat what you can't identify. Thorns and oily skins mean poison. Test a small piece first, rub it on your skin and wait.”
fruit.examineBlue: Smooth skin, a soft blue glow, a faint sweet smell. No reaction on your skin. Probably safe.
fruit.examineRed: Hard thorns and an oily red skin. Your fingers tingle where you touched it. Bad idea.
fruit.ateBlue: Sweet and strange: like pear and pepper. Your body accepts it.
fruit.ateRed: Your stomach cramps violently. That was a mistake.
msg.drink: Cold, metallic, clean enough. The suit filter agrees.
msg.drinkFull: You are not thirsty right now.
msg.deep: Too deep. You can't swim in this suit.
msg.thirsty: Your throat is burning. You need water.
msg.night: Night is falling. Bioluminescence wakes up across the forest.
death.title: YOU DID NOT SURVIVE
death.text: This world does not forgive mistakes. But you remember what went wrong.
objectives.title: Objectives: The First 24 Hours
crew.title: The Crew
crew.note: Find your friends to unlock their skills.
crew.scientist.name: Zenvik
crew.scientist.line: {lin}. Two doctorates. Can explain a black hole, cannot open a jar.
crew.strong.name: Draxum
crew.strong.line: Korrath-human from the foundries of Titan. Horns, ember seams, three hundred aura points. Softest heart in the crew. Will deny it.
crew.medic.name: Lyrra
crew.medic.line: Vael-human from the garden domes of Mars. Long ears, a brow sigil, and a voice that has never been raised. Her sarcasm has a licence.
crew.explorer.name: Skyvra
crew.explorer.line: Tarnkin-human from the ice caravans of Ganymede. Striped, tailed, and permanently on a side quest. Keeps a ledger of snack debts.
crew.builder.name: Bolzar
crew.builder.line: Ortek-human from the shipyards of Ceres. Jade skin, glowing orange eyes, a tool for everything. Everything he builds will hold. Allegedly.
crew.social.name: Nuvexa
crew.social.line: Sirelle-human from the cloud cities of Venus. Cobalt skin, gold star marks, antennae that know the vibe. Forty million followers, one real friend group.
level.4.desc: Night is coming. Gather dry moss for tinder, build a fire pit at your camp and strike stones until a spark catches.
level.4.hint: Your camp site glows near the pod. Dry moss grows in the open clearing.
level.5.desc: Cut giant fronds and gather branches, then build a lean-to beside the fire.
level.5.hint: Giant fronds grow at the edge of the forest.
level.6.desc: Something hunts here at night. Lash a flint point to a straight branch with glowvine.
level.6.hint: Flint shards lie among the rocks; glowvine coils on the ground under the trees.
level.7.desc: Rest at the shelter until dark. When the predator comes, brace your spear as it charges. Then sleep until dawn.
level.7.hint: Press E the moment it snarls and charges, not before.
level.8.desc: Your wrist device picked up a crew signal, too weak to locate. Climb to the crystal ridge and tune it.
level.8.hint: The higher you climb, the stronger the signal.
level.9.desc: Follow the signal to the second escape pod. Help whoever you find there and bring them back to camp.
level.9.hint: Follow the marker: and the smoke from the second pod.
level.10.desc: Salvage your pod's transmitter, gather metal scrap for a reflector, assemble a beacon at camp and switch it on.
level.10.hint: Metal scrap from your pod lies scattered along the crash furrow.
level.arc.title: Chapter One Complete
level.arc.desc: The beacon is lit. Four friends answered, and something else did too. Chapter Two, Finding the Friends, comes in a future build. Explore freely.
level.arc.toast: End of Chapter One. Thank you for playing, explore freely.
progress.strikes: Fire pit ready · strike for a spark ({k}/{n})
progress.restDusk: Rest at the shelter until nightfall
progress.sleep: Sleep in the shelter until dawn
progress.highGround: Climb to the crystal ridge and tune your device
progress.findCrew: Follow the signal to the second escape pod
progress.salvage: Salvage the transmitter from your pod
msg.pitBuilt: Stones in a ring, branches stacked like a tent. Now a spark.
msg.strike1: Sparks jump into the moss… and die.
msg.strike2: A thin curl of smoke. Again.
msg.fireLit: Fire! Warmth, light: and something that keeps the dark at a distance.
msg.shelterBuilt: A lean-to of branches and giant fronds. Not a home, but a roof.
msg.spearCrafted: Flint lashed to a straight branch with glowvine. You feel a little less like prey.
msg.restDusk: You rest by the fire while the light fades…
msg.sleeping: You crawl into the shelter and close your eyes…
msg.houndNear: Eyes in the dark. Six of them.
msg.houndHit: The spear finds its mark. It shrieks and backs off.
msg.houndBit: It bites and darts back into the dark!
msg.houndMiss: You stab at empty air. Wait until it charges.
msg.houndFled: It is gone: for now. Sleep while you can.
msg.slept: You wake at dawn. Stiff, cold, and alive.
msg.transmitter: You pull the emergency transmitter out of the pod. Its battery still holds a charge.
msg.beaconBuilt: Tripod up, transmitter mounted, scrap panels as a reflector.
msg.crewFollow: {f:explorer} is following you. Lead the way back to camp.
msg.crewAtCamp: {f:explorer} sinks down by the fire with a long sigh.
signal.detect2: TOO WEAK TO LOCATE · SEEK HIGH GROUND
dlg.7.1: Fire, roof, spear. My stats are kind of mid, but I'll take it. Now I wait for the dark.
dlg.8.1: A crew signal! Too weak from down here. Great. Looks like I'm doing cardio.
dlg.8.found: {f:explorer}! She's alive. Hold on, I'm coming. I'll even pay the snack debt.
memory.explorer: You remember {f:explorer} on the observation deck, laughing: “If we ever crash somewhere, I'm the one who finds the way home. You just bring the snacks.”
dlg.9.1: Is someone there? {f:scientist}?! If you're a hallucination, you still owe me snacks.
dlg.9.2: I'm real. Bad news: so is the debt. Are you hurt?
dlg.9.3: My leg is cooked. And I've been listening to that giant thing walk all night. I named it Greg.
dlg.9.4: Hold still. Branch and vine. I watched a Tiktak about this once.
dlg.9.5: Ow! That video was not accurate! Okay. Okay. Lead the way.
dlg.9.6: A real fire. {f:scientist}, you might actually be a genius. Don't let it go to your hair.
dlg.10.1: Every pod has an emergency transmitter. Pull yours, find scrap, we build a beacon. It's giving civilisation.
dlg.10.2: If anyone else survived, they'll hear it.
dlg.10.3: They're alive. All of them. {f:scientist}, they're alive!
dlg.10.4: Origin: Earth? None of us has ever even been to Earth.
dlg.10.5: That isn't a crew channel. That signal is older than our ship.
beacon.1: BEACON ONLINE · TRANSMITTING ON ALL CREW CHANNELS
beacon.unknown1: INCOMING · SOURCE UNKNOWN · BENEATH YOUR POSITION
beacon.unknown3: “…YOU WERE NOT THE FIRST TO ARRIVE.”
chapter.end2: Next: Chapter Two: Finding the Friends
crew.st.signal.social: Signal received · 7.8 km, beyond the mountains
vo.anon.medic.hint: You remember the Medic: “Never eat what you can't identify. Thorns and oily skins mean poison. Test a small piece first, rub it on your skin and wait.”
vo.anon.memory.explorer: You remember the Explorer on the observation deck, laughing: “If we ever crash somewhere, I'm the one who finds the way home. You just bring the snacks.”
vo.anon.dlg.8.found: It's her! She's alive. Hold on, I'm coming. I'll even pay the snack debt.
vo.anon.dlg.9.1: Is someone there? Is that you?! If you're a hallucination, you still owe me snacks.
vo.anon.dlg.9.6: A real fire. You might actually be a genius. Don't let it go to your hair.
vo.anon.dlg.10.3: They're alive. All of them. They're alive!
inv.title: Inventory
inv.note: Materials are used automatically when you build or craft at a station.
itemdesc.stone: Fist-sized and heavy. Fire pits, tools.
itemdesc.branch: Dry, straight wood. Fire, shelter, spear shafts, splints.
itemdesc.fruit: Glowpod: blue, sweet, safe to eat.
itemdesc.tinder: Dry moss that catches a spark.
itemdesc.frond: A giant leaf, tough and waterproof. Roofing.
itemdesc.flint: A sharp shard that holds an edge.
itemdesc.vine: Glowing, stretchy cord for lashing things together.
itemdesc.scrap: Hull plating from your pod. Reflectors, frames.
itemdesc.spear: Flint, branch and glowvine. Brace it when something charges.
itemdesc.transmitter: The pod's emergency transmitter. Still holds a charge.
tut.head: TRAINING · {k}/{n}
tut.complete: Training complete. You can replay it from Settings.
tut.look.title: Look around
tut.look.kbm: Move the mouse to look. Click the world first to lock the cursor (Esc frees it).
tut.look.touch: Drag your finger anywhere on the right of the screen to look around.
tut.move.title: Walk
tut.move.kbm: Use W A S D (or the arrow keys) to walk a few steps.
tut.move.touch: Put your thumb on the left of the screen and push to walk, the joystick appears where you touch.
tut.sprint.title: Sprint
tut.sprint.kbm: Hold Shift while walking forward to sprint. Sprinting drains the green stamina bar.
tut.sprint.touch: Tap Run, then push the joystick forward. Running drains the green stamina bar; stop to switch it off.
tut.jump.title: Jump
tut.jump.kbm: Press Space to jump over roots and rocks.
tut.jump.touch: Tap Jump to hop over roots and rocks.
tut.interact.title: Pick something up
tut.interact.kbm: The ◆ on the compass marks a stone or branch nearby. Walk up to it and press E when the prompt appears.
tut.interact.touch: The ◆ on the compass marks a stone or branch nearby. Walk up to it and tap the glowing Use button.
tut.inventory.title: Your inventory
tut.inventory.kbm: Everything you carry shows in the bar at the bottom. Press I (or Tab) to open the full inventory, then close it.
tut.inventory.touch: Tap Bag to open your inventory, then close it.
tut.crew.title: Your crew
tut.crew.kbm: Press C to see your five friends, their skills and what you know about them.
tut.crew.touch: Tap Crew to see your five friends, their skills and what you know about them.
tut.objectives.title: Objectives
tut.objectives.kbm: Your current goal is always shown top right. Press J for the full list of levels.
tut.objectives.touch: Your current goal is shown at the top. Tap Goals for the full list of levels.
tut.compass.title: Follow the compass
tut.compass.kbm: The ◆ on the compass points to whatever you need next, with the distance below it. Right now: water. Sprint with Shift to get there faster.
tut.compass.touch: The ◆ on the compass points to whatever you need next, with the distance below it. Right now: water. Turn until the ◆ is in the middle and walk.
op.1: Okay besties, squad selfie, galactic core in the back. {f:strong}, chin down, your horns are photobombing.
vo.anon.op.1: Okay besties, squad selfie, galactic core in the back. Big guy, chin down, your horns are photobombing.
op.2: Bro. The horns are the aura.
op.3: Your aura just blocked the emergency exit.
op.4: Who ate my snacks? {f:scientist}. Look me in the eyes.
vo.anon.op.4: Who ate my snacks? You. Yes, you. Look me in the eyes.
op.5: Technically the snacks were communal. I have a spreadsheet.
op.6: He has a spreadsheet. We're cooked. He has been cooked since Europa.
op.7: Relax. I tightened the big window myself. It'll hold.
op.8: You said that on Ceres. That is why I carry three kinds of burn cream.
op.9: Straight on Snapgram. Caption: six lineages, one brain cell.
op.11: Me. It's always me. Which is why nobody asked how I got us this route for free.
op.12: Wait. Free? You said Lamazon Orbit had a sale.
op.13: It was lowkey a beta route. Unlisted. Slightly closer to the centre.
op.14: Bro. You booked us a side quest at a black hole.
op.15: It's an observation corridor. Perfectly safe. No cap.
op.16: You said no cap. That is how I know it's cap.
op.17: Guys. Why are the stars moving?
op.18: That reading is impossible. Gravity doesn't do that.
op.19: Okay. Not funny. {f:scientist}, tell me this is a prank.
vo.anon.op.19: Okay. Not funny. Tell me this is a prank.
op.20: It's not a prank. Everyone, get away from the glass.
vo.anon.op.21: Hey! You still owe me snacks!
vo.anon.wake.line3: Hello? Squad? Anyone? Bro, even the group chat is dead.
dlg.4.1: Ancient people did this with rocks. I have two doctorates. How hard can it be.
dlg.4.3: Zero stars. Would not strike again. Lamazon lied about this survival kit.
dlg.4.4: Fire! I am literally the main character! And nobody saw it. Of course nobody saw it.
fb.1: A memory, arriving uninvited. Day thirty-nine. The fight nobody posted.
fb.2: You're not even listening, bro. Nine days staring at that screen.
fb.3: Because the numbers are wrong, and nobody here can count past their follower count!
fb.4: Wow. Okay. Say that again, Mister Spreadsheet. Say it to my face.
fb.5: Enough. We have forty days of corridor left and one bathroom.
fb.6: He thinks he's better than us. Lab people always do.
fb.8: Hey! He's my idiot, not yours. Group hug or I'm airlocking the snacks.
fb.9: The friendship, I mean. It'll hold.
fb.10: I never said sorry. If you're out there, {f:strong}, I'm sorry.
vo.anon.fb.10: I never said sorry. If you're out there, big guy, I'm sorry.
dlg.7.2: That's six eyes. Six. Why does it need six.
dlg.7.3: Aura points: plus one thousand. I am shaking. But plus one thousand.
dlg.9.7: I thought I was the only one left.
dlg.9.8: Me too. I talked to Greg for a whole day. Terrible listener. I'm really glad it's you.
rad.strong: Bro. Bro! Is that you? I've been wrestling a tree for two days. The tree is winning.
rad.medic: I've catalogued nine poisonous plants without eating any. Tell {f:builder} to stop licking things.
vo.anon.rad.medic: I've catalogued nine poisonous plants without eating any. Tell our builder to stop licking things.
rad.builder: Your beacon's a bit crooked. Sounds like it, I mean. But it'll hold.
rad.social: Besties! I have one percent battery, zero followers on this planet, and I look incredible.
dlg.10.6: Wait. Your wrist log. Course change, authorised by you. {f:scientist}, why is your name on this?
vo.anon.dlg.10.6: Wait. Your wrist log. Course change, authorised by you. Why is your name on this?
dlg.10.7: What? No. I booked a corridor. I never touched navigation.
dlg.10.8: Look at me. No jokes. Did you bring us here on purpose?
dlg.10.9: I swear on every snack I owe you. I don't know who used my login.
dlg.10.10: Okay. I believe you. Lowkey terrified, but I believe you. So who did?
mz.intro.1: Oh good. Another one. Wipe your feet. This is the edge of a black hole and I have just had it cleaned.
mz.intro.2: I am MegaZroN, keeper of the Last Ledger. I write down how every story ends. Yes, yours. No, you may not see it.
mz.intro.3: Six friends are about to have the funniest day of their lives. Then the worst. It's a tight schedule.
mz.intro.4: Everything you do is written here. What you eat. Whom you trust. How many times you walk into a tree.
mz.intro.5: Go on, then. Try to surprise me. Nobody has in nine thousand years, but I do love watching people try.
mz.l3.1: Water, food, sticks. The oldest speedrun in the universe, and you have finished it. Slowly.
mz.l3.red: You ate the thornberry. After it tingled. I have underlined that in the Ledger. Twice.
mz.l3.safe: You examined the fruit before eating it. How disappointing. I had already sharpened my pencil.
mz.l3.died: And you have already died. Lovely. My favourite chapter is the one that restarts.
mz.l3.hint: A free hint, since you look tired. Dry moss likes open sky. You should try it.
mz.l3.2: Night is coming. Fire is not a comfort here. It is a door you are holding shut.
mz.l7.1: You survived a night. Most pages in this room stop around there, so: mild applause.
mz.l7.clean: Not one bite! That hound went home and told all six of its eyes about you.
mz.l7.bitten: It bit you. It reports that you taste of burnt coffee and poor planning.
mz.l7.2: Now listen to your wrist. Signals carry further in the cold, and not all of them want to be found.
mz.l7.hint: Go up. On this world the truth always sits somewhere inconvenient.
mz.ch1.1: The beacon is lit. Four friends answered. So did something that read your family tree like a menu.
mz.ch1.names: You renamed your crew. Sweet. Something down there already has their real names, and has had them for a very long time.
mz.ch1.nonames: Six names, six signals. Keep them close. Something down there collects names.
mz.ch1.2: Subjects: six. Origin: Earth. Funny, isn't it? Not one of you has ever stood on Earth. And yet you were recognised.
mz.ch1.3: Ninety-nine steps lie between you and the truth. Every one has been walked before. Check the footprints. Check the shoe size.
mz.ch1.4: See you next chapter, little traveller. I'll keep your seat warm. I always do.
mz.name: MegaZroN
j.1: Mum texted. 'Reached? Ate? Wear a jacket.' Twenty-six thousand light-years, and she still has signal.
j.2: If one more person says six-seven, I am sedating the entire group chat.
j.3: Task failed successfully. That's my whole engineering career, in one sentence.
j.4: Water. Flavour: two stars. Hydration arc complete. Touch grass achievement unlocked, sadly.
j.6: Respawn granted. This time, try using the eyes you were issued.
j.7: Greg walked past again. He's giving landlord energy.
j.8: In my day we walked to the singularity uphill, both ways, on dial-up.
j.9: We are six. Seven, counting my biceps.

skins.title: Crew skins
skins.note: A cosmetic change. Applies everywhere the crewmate appears.
skins.ok: Unlocked. The Ledger is impressed. Slightly.
skins.wrong: Wrong. MegaZroN has noted this in the Ledger. In pen.
npc.trader.hi: Welcome to Lamazon Rock Delivery. Two branches, one flint. No refunds, no returns, no planet.
npc.trader.done: Pleasure. Five stars, please. I have a family of rocks to feed.
npc.trader.no: No branches, no deal. This is capitalism with extra steps.
npc.local.hi: Small warm one. You walk loud. The ground has filed a complaint.
npc.local.ask: Bring one stone. I give one vine. We call this economy. You call it please.
npc.local.done: Good. You may continue being loud.
npc.hermit.1: You'll stop at ninety-nine. They always do. Sorry, wrong century.
npc.hermit.2: I've met you before. You were taller. You also owed me snacks.
npc.trav.1: Excuse me, is this the queue for the refund desk? I've been here nine years.
npc.trav.2: My review will be brutal. One star. That one, up there, and it is leaving.
npc.cameo.1: Sorry, is this the eleven o'clock? I was told business casual.
npc.cameo.2: I don't know how I got here either. But the lapels are holding.

legal.template: These pages are templates and have not been reviewed by a lawyer.
legal.terms: BEYOND SAGITTARIUS is a free game by megazron. Play it and share links to it for personal use. Don't resell it or publish modified copies without permission. It comes with no warranty: it may have bugs, change or go offline, and saves can be lost. To the extent the law allows, megazron is not liable for loss or damage from using it.
legal.privacy: No accounts, adverts, analytics or tracking of our own. Your save, settings and character stay in local storage on your device. The web version is served by GitHub Pages, and fonts load from Google Fonts in the browser and the desktop app, so those services see your IP address and browser details.
legal.safety: Do not try this at home. The science is simplified for a game and is not instructions. Made for a general teen audience: comic horror, peril and mild creature violence. Younger players should play with a parent or guardian.
legal.parody: Characters and events are made up. Names such as Lamazon are invented parodies used for humour. No real company is involved or endorses this game.
legal.licences: Game code, art and story: all rights reserved, megazron. Built with three.js (MIT). Textures, models and the HDRI are CC0 from Poly Haven. Voices are synthetic. The full list with every licence is in CREDITS.md on GitHub.
